member.summary: Read-only list of input devices that will be allowed to appear in the Joysticks list in Rewired. By default, all devices will be allowed even though they do not appear in this list. The provides device matching critera. To modify the list, replace it by setting this value with a new list. and are used to determine which devices are allowed to appear in the Joysticks list. Allowed devices in this list will override disallowed devices in . The only reason to set allowed devices is if you have already set disallowed devices using wide-matching device identifiers, but want to re-allow specific devices using narrow-matching identifiers.

member.name: P:Rewired.Platforms.Apple.GameController.GCControllerInput.disallowedDevices

To disallow a wide category of devices while allowing only specific exceptions, set allow overrides in .
